name: Silence the Keeper
brief: The keeper of the Hanged Ferryman kept a ledger, and your name is in it. He does not know you yet. See that he never has the chance to say it aloud — before the round is out, the keeper must be dead.
notes: D-526's low-cast workhorse. A fixed, known, defenceless target turns the round from 'who is the traitor' (thin at three) into 'the keeper must live' (a defence problem at any size). The antagonist is exposed by what it does, not by a coin-flip accusation.
